features.heading: From year one to final exams — one app for mastering a mountain of material.
features.intro: Do not read the same notes for the fifth time. Answer, check and revisit material exactly when you need to.

value.heading: Ready-made medical decks
value.text: Learn from structured sets covering anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, pathophysiology and clinical subjects.

problem.heading: Active recall
problem.text: Every card makes you retrieve information from memory. That works better than passively rereading another handout.

how.heading: Smart reviews
how.text: The algorithm shows difficult questions more often and mastered ones less often, so your time goes where it matters.

simulation.heading: Clinical context
simulation.text: Connect facts with short patient cases and practice reasoning instead of memorizing isolated definitions.

why.heading: Progress you can see
why.text: Know which topics are solid, where reviews are piling up and what deserves attention before your next exam.

built.heading: Made for student life
built.text: Short sessions fit between classes, on the commute and before a quiz. No tedious card creation from scratch.

features.footerNote: Recall the answer first. Then check it. That is where real learning begins.
